name: pymc_jax_s1
busy_cpus_note: average number of busy logical CPUs during the run, inside and outside the taskset list; work outside it is other work on the machine (CPUs 12-23 are the SMT siblings of 0-11, so it competes for the same cores)

extra.gradients_note: sum of n_steps over warmup and draws plus one per chain for the initial point
extra.compile_note: build_model (PyMC graph) is reported separately; compile = nutpie.compile_pymc_model (PyTensor rewrites and numba/JAX compilation); JAX also traces and compiles lazily on first call, which then falls in sampling
extra.sampling_note: the nutpie.sample() call (sampling and storing the trace in memory, warmup included)
extra.settings: PyMC 5.28.5, nutpie 0.16.11 compile_pymc_model(backend='jax', gradient_backend='pytensor'), sample(tune 1000, draws 1000, chains 4, cores 4), defaults otherwise (adaptation 'diag', maxdepth 10, target accept 0.8, save_warmup True)
